description:
The 'stats' switch case handles parsed.help by printing STATS_HELP, then delegates to dispatchStats which handles help again (index.ts:2024). Harmless duplication; could delegate the help branch entirely to dispatchStats.

Source: cam/issue-136
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 950af7f7ce89

spec.scope: In index.ts, remove the duplicated help handling in the 'stats' switch case (which prints STATS_HELP then delegates to dispatchStats, which handles help again at index.ts:2024). Delegate the help branch entirely to dispatchStats so help is printed exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'stats' switch case no longer prints STATS_HELP itself; the help branch is handled solely by dispatchStats.
`cam stats --help` prints the stats help exactly once with unchanged content.
gotchas: The duplication is currently harmless; this is a clarity cleanup.
